newsitem.title: FRANCE: Swissair staff suspend Paris cargo strike.
newsitem.headline: Swissair staff suspend Paris cargo strike.

text.p: Swissair staff at Paris-Charles de Gaulle have suspended strike action which had severely hit the airline's cargo activities at the airport for the past three days, a CDG-based Swissair cargo official told Reuters on Wednesday.
"The strike was suspended at 1600 local time(1400 gmt) but it's impossible to say how long this decision will be in force. The strike has been suspended not called off," he added.
Cargo staff had returned to work but the official could not say whether a trucking service scheduled for this evening to Switzerland would go ahead.
The dispute centres on Swissair's French restructuring programme which involves cutting 66 jobs, including around 25 staff in cargo handling operations, which will be outsourced from January 1 1997.

"With the exception of some valuables shipments, there has been no freight leaving from or arriving at Swissair's installations at CDG for the past three days," the official added. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
